title: Opentrons Logo Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Make sure to add reagents to your labware before placing it on the deck! Your food dye solution should be in your labware and your destination plate should be empty.

steps.title: Gather required labware and dyes
steps.instruction: Obtain a clean, empty 96‑well plate, a 12‑row trough or a tube rack with 1.5 mL or 2 mL tubes, and two food‑dye solutions. If using a trough, place dye 1 in column 1 and dye 2 in column 2. If using a tube rack, place dye 1 in wells A1 and B1, and dye 2 in wells C1 and D1.

steps.title: Add reagents to source labware
steps.instruction: Dispense the prepared food‑dye solutions into the designated trough columns or tube‑rack wells, and keep the destination 96‑well plate empty before placing it on the robot deck.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, select the pipette model, specify the pipette mount (left or right), choose the destination plate type, and set the dye source labware type (trough or tube rack) as described.

steps.title: Download customized OT‑2 protocol
steps.instruction: Click the blue “Download” button located above the deck map to save the generated OT‑2 protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol and run robot
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file in the Opentrons app, arrange the deck to match the labware layout, perform labware calibration, and start the run.
